title: Sella, clinoid processes and sphenoidal grooves
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Locate nine original author annotations in the source sphenoid model. Compare complete bone context with focused views of the sella, clinoid processes and adjacent grooves, retaining the original source locations and model geometry.

scenes.title: Sella turcica · whole sphenoid context
scenes.prompt: Locate the marker within the whole source sphenoid and describe its relationship to the central sellar region.
scenes.note: Sella turcica. Original source author label endpoint on the Sphenoid bone object, evaluated with its stored Hook and native metric transform. The marker identifies an authored location and the surrounding bone provides the displayed geometry. Source labels retain their original wording; regional laterality follows the source naming.
